title: Palm Oil Investment, Fiscal & Biofuel Feedstock Intelligence
classification: Curated dated sources, not live national accounts

investment.palm_2025_status: BKPM's 2025 palm-oil downstream PMA/PMDN LKPM dataset is public, but its numeric aggregation has not yet been independently verified; no invented palm-only amount.
investment.definition: Rp144.5 trillion is the COMBINED plantation-and-forestry downstream investment category: NOT a palm-only investment value. The total does not isolate plantation from forestry, nor palm from other plantation crops.
investment.next: Aggregate BKPM's 2025 palm-oil downstream LKPM CSV by unique year/quarter/project definitions, split PMA/PMDN and province, check for revisions, then publish a palm-only measured figure.

fiscal.attribution: Government minister's 21 July 2026 public statement via BPDP.
fiscal.scope: Combined palm export levy (pungutan ekspor) and export duty (bea keluar), as publicly cited. These have different collection and accounting arrangements; Rp53.13tn is NOT validated as a single APBN tax receipt.
fiscal.breakdown_note: A separately reconciled fiscal ledger is needed for APBN export duties, BPDP levies/program funding, and income/VAT/land taxes. These must not be summed with exports or investments.

trade.exports_2025_definition: GAPKI palm oil and derivatives export value; NOT fiscal state revenue.
trade.method: GAPKI reported industry series through Aug 2026. Jan–Aug YTD cannot be compared to a full-year 2025 figure as annual growth. Production/consumption measures are by mass, not FAME kL.

materials.title: Oil-palm fruit / Fresh Fruit Bunches (FFB)
materials.description: Harvest to palm mills. Palm estates and smallholder supply chains require replanting, yields, legality and land-use due diligence.

materials.title: CPO / refined palm oil
materials.description: Food, oleochemical, export and fuel uses compete for upstream palm feedstock. CPO tonnes are not equivalent to FAME kilolitres.

materials.title: FAME biodiesel / B50 blending
materials.description: Palm oil is the dominant feedstock for Indonesia's FAME biodiesel mandate; production capacity, allocation and physical distribution are separate measurements.

materials.title: SAF / renewable diesel
materials.description: May use multiple approved lipid/waste feedstocks and distinct processing technology; do not assume all SAF is palm-derived.

materials.title: Bioethanol
materials.description: Typically derived from sugar/starch crops such as sugarcane, cassava or maize, NOT palm oil; track separately from biodiesel.

actors.name: PTPN IV PalmCo
actors.role: State-linked upstream plantations & mills; under PTPN III holding
actors.status: Existing operating actor; NOT a new investment commitment
actors.note: H1 2026 corporate revenue, NOT APBN income or capital investment.

actors.name: BKPM LKPM palm-oil downstream register
actors.role: Official PMA/PMDN investor and province breakdown
actors.status: Downloadable official dataset; project list pending normalization
actors.note: Inspect registered investee projects before claiming ownership, capital deployed, countries or capacity.

actors.name: BPDP
actors.role: Palm levy collection and programme financing; biodiesel and smallholder replanting
actors.note: BPDP receipts and spending are not automatically equivalent to APBN export duty proceeds.

risk_watch: CPO international prices and milling margins
Export levy/duty changes and BPDP programme funding
B50 FAME feedstock sufficiency versus food and oleochemicals
Smallholder replanting, tenure, deforestation and certification
New downstream refinery/oleochemical/SAF plant: FID versus operating status

definitions: Export value, company revenue, government-collected levies/duties, tax revenue and investment are distinct financial concepts. No totals across them.
